description: A React component for displaying and editing a user's profile information, including username and bio, with toggleable edit mode and controlled form inputs.

methods.name: ProfilePage({ user, onUpdateProfile })
methods.description: React functional component that manages profile display and editing state, rendering user info or an editable form based on the mode.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the profile state when form inputs change.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls onUpdateProfile callback, and exits edit mode.
